stem: Which sentence should replace sentence 37 to bring this paper to a more effective conclusion?

options.label: A
options.text: With compassion, we should all do our part to save P. oceanica for future generations, regardless of our personal preferences.

options.label: B
options.text: Many are hopeful that these efforts, combined with the world’s growing awareness of this plant’s essential role, will be enough to ensure P. oceanica’s survival.

options.label: C
options.text: These unusual water plants are of extreme value, and experts in biology say there is little argument about this statement.

options.label: D
options.text: Some will be sure to insist that this plant is just as important as other plants and animals that are currently being protected by international agencies.
